name: 知屿

steps.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: final Windows desktop application icon, one square icon only.
Primary request: Design a distinctive, polished app icon for a Chinese personal research and daily learning workspace named 知屿 (Zhiyu). The app combines scholarly PDF reading, translation, learning, projects and daily planning, with a warm field-journal aesthetic. Create an ORIGINAL visual mark, no text or letters.
Subject: a single bold and ingenious geometric silhouette in which an OPEN BOOK subtly becomes a small tranquil ISLAND: two broad cream paper leaves rise from a terracotta book-spine/base, and one softly shaped sage-green landform nestles in the page curvature. The book and island should read as ONE integrated emblem, not a collage. One tiny warm amber sun disc above the open-page valley is permitted if it strengthens the overall silhouette.
Composition: square 1024x1024; centered app tile with large smooth rounded corners, occupying about 90% of the canvas; genuine transparent canvas outside the rounded tile. Warm oat-paper tile background, rich terracotta symbol, small sage-green accent, cream negative-space pages. Emblem fills 65-72% of the tile with generous but not excessive padding. Balanced, bold enough to work at 24px. Front view, no perspective tilt.
Style: premium contemporary editorial app branding, crisp vector-like boundaries rendered as a high-quality raster, soft restrained material depth, barely perceptible warm edge shading. Simple architectural geometry, slightly human/organic curves; clear light-dark contrast. This is an application icon, not a busy journal illustration.
Avoid: thin outlines, tiny decorative details, lettering, words, calligraphy, initials, monograms, gradients that wash out the emblem, watercolor splatter, photo mockups, scenery, a literal desk, multiple books, clocks, checkmarks, magnifiers, mortarboards, generic chatbot sparkles, outer drop shadows beyond the tile, borders around the entire canvas, checkerboard background, any existing company's logo.
Output: exactly one finished centered app icon on true transparent exterior.

steps.prompt: Edit the just-generated Zhiyu application icon. Keep the same icon identity, palette, open cream book/terracotta cover, sage island, amber sun, and centered square composition. Make just these production refinements: replace the rough, splattered outer perimeter with an EXACTLY smooth rounded-square silhouette and truly transparent exterior, eliminating ALL stray light pixels outside the silhouette. Reduce paper-grain texture substantially so the surface is calm and almost flat, with only very restrained material shading. Increase the terracotta-versus-cream separation slightly for small-size readability. Preserve the emblem's geometry and overall balance. Do not add text, letters, outlines, objects or shadows outside the rounded tile. Output one square desktop app icon, no mockup.

steps.prompt: Production cleanup of this same Zhiyu app icon. Keep the open cream book, terracotta base, sage island hills and amber sun exactly recognizable. Change ONLY the backdrop treatment: make the ENTIRE 1024x1024 canvas a clean, fully OPAQUE, uninterrupted warm ivory background (#F4E6D2), full bleed to all four edges. Remove the rounded-square container and every outer halo, splatter, cutout, shadow, rough margin and transparency artifact. This final icon is deliberately a FULL-BLEED SQUARE with flat warm ivory corners. The central mark should be crisp, simple, calm, almost flat and well centered. No grain/no mottling, no text, no letters, no frame, no mockup. Preserve broad cream pages distinguished against the ivory background by the terracotta book cover. Emblem composition and palette stay the same.
